definitions.ask: Should `]S`/`[S` and `]W`/`[W` set their lowercase type, so `]]` then steps that walk?
definitions.why: The types are named by letter, and repeating an endpoint jump never moves anywhere.

choices.label: `]]` steps `]s` after `]S`, and walks the landed lane with `]w` after `]W`
`S` / `W` are own types: `]]` re-jumps to POST after `]S` and cycles lanes after `]W`

definitions.ask: Should `[<Space>` / `]<Space>` (insert blank line above / below) also become a repeatable type?
definitions.why: A stray `]]` should never edit a note.

choices.label: Blank-line inserts leave the remembered type alone, so `]]` / `[[` only ever navigate
After `]<Space>`, `]]` / `[[` insert blank lines below / above until another walk is used
